sourceFacts: male, age and appearance unconfirmed, Old City committee supervisory commissioner and ordinary human
public image is a clean, pragmatic technical bureaucrat who has appeared in media interviews about transparent reconstruction
actually a mature cautious corruption operator who gives only direction and leaves no direct orders, keeping dirty work at least two intermediaries away
standard portrait must preserve the surface warmth and proper civil-service posture rather than reveal villainy through supernatural darkness, money vision or an openly sinister costume
designAssumptions: provisional age forty-eight, composed Chinese man with neatly side-parted black hair greying at the temples, warm brown eyes and a mild trustworthy face
wears a conservative charcoal civil-service suit, pale blue collared shirt, muted grey-blue tie, simple tie clip, straight trousers and polished black shoes
stands upright with his own hands loosely together at the waist and a restrained courteous smile suitable for a public reconstruction interview

User-review redesign: A coldly courteous forty-eight-year-old Chinese supervisory commissioner with greying side-parted hair, one expensive mechanical eye and one impeccably articulated prosthetic hand adjusts his muted tie cuff without smiling, wearing a conservative charcoal civil-service suit under soft even frontal studio light; the strict cowboy shot ends at mid-thigh.
sceneConcept: A provisional design for a forty-eight-year-old Chinese supervisory commissioner stands alone against a transparent background. Neatly side-parted black hair greys at the temples, while warm brown eyes and a mild face project public trust. He wears a conservative charcoal civil-service suit, pale blue collared shirt, muted grey-blue tie, simple tie clip, straight trousers and polished black shoes. His own hands rest loosely together at the waist beneath a restrained courteous smile suitable for a reconstruction interview. Soft even frontal studio light preserves the respectable public image.
